title: feat: functional supervised local tools
body:
## Summary

Phase 9 adds a bounded, Owner-supervised local-tool boundary while preserving the standalone AIP scope. Workspace inspection is metadata-only; local organization is limited to an explicitly configured Owner root with preview, approval, second confirmation, dry-run, source-identity revalidation, safe moves, rollback, and compensation. Calendar and messaging remain provider-neutral fixture mocks.

## Implementation

- `f5ec675` implements the Phase 9 supervised tool catalog, sessions, permissions, actions, audit, migration, and fixture adapters.
- `7324801` hardens root policy, symlink/reparse checks, canonical containment, and partial-move safety.
- `23cbdeb` wires the TypeScript contracts, Tauri UI, local-root controls, and Phase 9 documentation.
- `a665850` adds stable per-move compensation identity and fail-closed compensation preflight.
- `dfeee2f` bounds nullable audit action/session identifiers.
- `3ae7a9e` bounds all supervised-tool collections at the contract boundary.
- `77b65d2` persists Rust-captured source identity and enforces Rust collection maxima.
- `5864d52` ignores caller-supplied source identity for authority.
- `9a77344` rejects nested symlink/junction/reparse components before canonicalization.

## Evidence

- Final HEAD: `9a7734460dded5469acd5e746f3118c9e3d28054`; remote branch was fast-forwarded from `06414e05765fe96f3e6fd736775c70e21187d5bb` and exact SHA reverified.
- Direct local gates: Rust fmt/check/clippy passed; `cargo test --locked --lib` passed `120`, failed `0`, with `1` optional Ollama test ignored; contracts typecheck/build/tests passed (`17`); desktop typecheck/tests/build passed (`49` + Vite build); `pnpm secrets:scan` passed (`148` files); `git diff --check` passed.
- Distinct Biel4 read-only final review: `approved_with_reservations`, no code findings.
- Codex Security diff scan `d0f1d38e-b294-4851-be22-60904fd16761` for `06414e0..9a77344`: complete coverage, zero findings. TAC advisory connector was unavailable (`USER_NOT_LOGGED_IN`).

## Boundaries and status

Rust/SQLite remain authoritative. No shell execution, network/provider access, upload, telemetry, watcher, public listener, credential storage, raw-content persistence, or Phase 10+ behavior was added. The documentation and gap matrix keep stable-release approval and packaged Windows/manual UX validation explicitly pending. Remote CI is not yet confirmed.

This PR is a functional Phase 9 checkpoint, not a stable-release claim. Packaged Windows 10 x64/manual filesystem and Owner-confirmation UX checks remain human reservations; merge must wait for protected remote CI and normal repository review.
